Pre-load to simplify assembly

features: No machining required
Parallel to mounting profile
Creates structural pivot ranging from 0-180 degrees
Slot tab helps prevent rotation, assists in alignment with T-slot
parts.dimension_notes: E = thru & counterbore hole (bolt size), F = tapped thru hole (thread), R. M = radius
